run_balance_cli_main: run the balance CLI main entry point to adjust sample weights from an input CSV file
process_batch_with_balance_cli: process a batch of data using BalanceCLI to compute adjusted weights and diagnostics
create_balance_cli_parser: create an argparse parser with all balance CLI arguments using make_parser
split_sample_dataframe: split a pandas DataFrame into sample and target partitions using BalanceCLI split_sample
check_input_columns_balance_cli: validate that required columns exist in the input DataFrame using BalanceCLI check_input_columns
